skill.name: explore-codebase
skill.description: Guides AI agents through efficient codebase exploration using targeted searches, parallel explorer subagents, and structured synthesis.
skill.summary: Explore codebases with targeted search, parallel subagents, and structured summaries.

content.value_statement: Large repositories are hard to understand before making changes. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a repeatable exploration workflow.
actual_capabilities: Shows when to use quick Glob and Grep searches for targeted discovery.
Defines when to spawn parallel explorer subagents for broad context gathering.
Provides a structured prompt format for explorer subagent tasks.
Specifies YAML fields for summarizing architecture, patterns, constraints, and gaps.
Distinguishes the custom explorer subagent from the built-in Explore agent.
limitations: Requires a configured explorer subagent for the broad exploration workflow.
Does not perform analysis itself; it describes a repeatable exploration pattern.
Does not include project-specific search terms, architecture rules, or validation steps.
Depends on tool support for Task, Read, Glob, and Grep.

use_cases.title: Prepare for a Code Change
use_cases.description: Gather the relevant files, patterns, and constraints before editing an unfamiliar feature area.

use_cases.title: Map an Unknown Repository
use_cases.description: Build a first-pass architecture summary for a project with many modules or services.

use_cases.title: Collect Architecture Evidence
use_cases.description: Compare patterns across subsystems before proposing a design or refactor.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Feature Area
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a known topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the explore-codebase skill to find where authentication logic lives. Start with targeted Glob and Grep searches, then summarize files, patterns, and gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate exploration across several repository areas.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explore the billing workflow. Spawn explorer subagents for API routes, data models, and tests. Return architecture summary, integration points, constraints, and unanswered questions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced discovery before changing shared code.
prompt_templates.prompt: Before changing the plugin loader, run broad exploration using parallel explorer subagents. Limit each subagent to one subsystem and synthesize cross-cutting patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Design Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture review for a new implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the repository for existing patterns that should guide a new caching layer. Compare service boundaries, invalidation approaches, tests, and documented constraints.

output_examples.output: A concise architecture summary identifies auth routes, session helpers, and test coverage. It also lists gaps such as missing token refresh examples.

output_examples.input: Find patterns before adding a billing webhook.
output_examples.output: The response compares existing webhook handlers, validation helpers, retry behavior, and integration points with billing models.

output_examples.input: Understand storage adapters before a refactor.
output_examples.output: The summary groups adapter implementations, shared interfaces, constraints, and uncertain areas that need direct follow-up.

best_practices: Start with narrow searches when the target is known, then broaden only when needed.
Give each explorer subagent a limited scope and a concrete question.
Synthesize findings into architecture, patterns, integration points, constraints, and gaps.
anti_patterns: Spawning broad subagents without scoped questions.
Treating subagent output as final without checking cited files.
Skipping synthesis and leaving findings as isolated notes.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant explore repositories, gather context, and summarize discovered patterns before implementation work.

faq.question: Does it run shell commands?
faq.answer: No. It describes Read, Glob, Grep, and Task tool usage, not shell execution.

faq.question: Do I need the custom explorer subagent?
faq.answer: Yes, the broad exploration workflow expects a lowercase explorer subagent to be configured.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is useful for Codex when similar search and subagent tools are available.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a structured summary of architecture, existing patterns, integration points, constraints, and gaps.

faq.question: Is it useful for small tasks?
faq.answer: Yes, but quick targeted searches are usually enough when the task has a clear file or function target.
